component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.rights.video.operations
component.documentation:
The platform's Video.* operations (nuxeo-platform-video's video tools), each replaced by one of the same id, parameters, inputs and answers that asks the asset's rights first: an input document's video, and Video.AddWatermark's watermark picture, are decided as a download of the same file would be (org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.rights), and refused with 403 when the rights do not cover it. Then the platform's own operation runs. A document no policy covers, and a blob given as the input, are not refused here.
It requires the platform's own contribution, so that it registers after it and replaces it. On a server without nuxeo-platform-video, it waits for it and replaces nothing.
